mapper.select:
select ee.ENTRUST_DATE entrustDate , ee.FINPROD_ID finprodId , fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId , fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr , fpi.ISSUE_CLASS issueClass , fpi.ISSUE_DATE issueDate , fpi.PAY_DATE payDate , fpi.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice , fpi.REFER_YIELD referenceRate , fpi.REFER_YIELD rate , eea.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId , ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName , ee.INV_MANAGER_ID invManagerName , ee.CCY ccy , ee.REMARK remark , pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName , eed.ENTRUST_NUM*100 bidPrinAmt , eed.INV_AIM businessModel from ETR_ENTRUST ee left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea on eea.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fpi.FINPROD_ID = ee.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai ON eea.SEC_ACCT_ID = ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on eed.ENTRUST_ID = ee.ENTRUST_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID
eed.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId} /*指令代码查询*/
mapper.sql: select issueStatus, finprodId, finprodMarketId, finprodAbbr, secManageAcctId, secAcctName, sum(subscriptionAmount) subscriptionAmount, sum(payableAmount) payableAmount, sum(settFeeAmt) settFeeAmt, rate, issueClass, issueDate, payDate, couponSpecies, intType, ouPartyId, ouPartyIdAbbr, issuer, issuerName from ( select fpa.ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, bobp.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT subscriptionAmount, bobp.PAYABLE_AMOUNT payableAmount, bobp.SETT_FEE_AMT settFeeAmt, case when fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' and fpi.INT_TYPE = '02' then nvl(miri.INT_RATE, 0) + nvl(fpi.REFER_YIELD, 0) else fpi.REFER_YIELD end rate, fpi.ISSUE_CLASS issueClass, fpi.ISSUE_DATE issueDate, fpi.PAY_DATE payDate, fp.COUPON_SPECIES couponSpecies, fpi.INT_TYPE intType, bo.OU_PARTY_ID ouPartyId, mcci.PARTY_ABBR ouPartyIdAbbr, fp.ISSUER issuer, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName from BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE bobp left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on bobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and bobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID left join BID_ORDER bo on bo.BID_ID = bobp.BID_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fpi.FINPROD_ID = bo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on fpa.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID left join MST_INT_RATE_INFO miri on miri.INT_RATE_ID = fpi.INT_RATE_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = bo.OU_PARTY_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fp.ISSUER WHERE bo.BID_DATE = #{sysDate} AND bo.IS_CANCEL = 'N' and bo.TRADE_STATUS != '03' and bobp.BID_PRICE = 99999999 union all select fpa.ISSUE_STATUS issueStatus, fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, eed.SEC_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId, ssai.SEC_ACCT_NAME secAcctName, 0 subscriptionAmount, 0 payableAmount, 0 settFeeAmt, case when fp.COUPON_SPECIES = '01' and fpi.INT_TYPE = '02' then nvl(miri.INT_RATE, 0) + nvl(fpi.REFER_YIELD, 0) else fpi.REFER_YIELD end rate, fpi.ISSUE_CLASS issueClass, fpi.ISSUE_DATE issueDate, fpi.PAY_DATE payDate, fp.COUPON_SPECIES couponSpecies, fpi.INT_TYPE intType, wbo.OU_PARTY_ID ouPartyId, mcci.PARTY_ABBR ouPartyIdAbbr, fp.ISSUER issuer, mci.CUSTOMER_NAME issuerName from WFL_BID_ORDER_BID_PRICE wbobp left join ETR_ENTRUST_DETAIL eed on wbobp.ENTRUST_ID = eed.ENTRUST_ID and wbobp.PORTFOLIO_ID = eed.PORTFOLIO_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ssai on ssai.SEC_ACCT_ID = eed.SEC_ACCT_ID left join WFL_BID_ORDER wbo on wbo.BID_ID = wbobp.BID_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = wbo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ISSUE fpi on fpi.FINPROD_ID = wbo.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on fpa.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID left join MST_INT_RATE_INFO miri on miri.INT_RATE_ID = fpi.INT_RATE_ID left join MST_CFETS_CUSTOMER_INFO mcci on mcci.PARTY_ID = wbo.OU_PARTY_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on mci.CUSTOMER_ID = fp.ISSUER WHERE wbo.BID_DATE = #{sysDate} and wbobp.BID_PRICE = 99999999 ) group by issueStatus, finprodId, finprodMarketId, finprodAbbr, secManageAcctId, secAcctName, rate, issueClass, issueDate, payDate, couponSpecies, intType, ouPartyId, ouPartyIdAbbr, issuer, issuerName order by decode(issueStatus,Null,1,'01',2,3)
